What is behind this picture? View all 36 answers + how to read them

This is a fictional sample using the actual 36 Innerly questions. Frequent supportive statements and infrequent challenge statements are grouped as strengths; the opposite responses suggest areas to explore. “Sometimes” stays a separate group. These are editorial reflection categories, not validated scores.

There is no validated general-population benchmark for this questionnaire, so this report does not rank your mental stability or show a population percentile. It is a reflection tool, not a diagnosis.
